name: Frost Bloom Mojito
instructions: Prepare the Frost Bloom Mint & Lime Soda: freeze fresh mint overnight, crush it, and infuse it for 24 hours in cold acidulated lime water (lime zest with citric and malic acid), then strain, sweeten to about 17% sugar by weight, and carbonate.
Fill a large highball glass with ice.
Add the rum and top with the Frost Bloom Mint & Lime Soda.
Stir gently and garnish with a mint leaf.
